title: Umkhosi Owahlangatyezwa NguFlying Clay
intro: Ngexesha langaphambi koMprofeti uMuhammad, umlawuli onamandla waseYemen waqalisa iphulo lomkhosi elalijolise ekutshabalaliseni indawo engcwele eMakkah. Olu tshaba lwalukhokela umkhosi omkhulu oneendlovu zemfazwe, ziqinisekile ngamandla azo kunye nenani lazo. Nangona kunjalo, uhambo lwazo lwaluza kuphela ngequbuliso njengoko zidibana nokungenelela okungalindelekanga kukaThixo. Ngaba ungamchaza obani ababejongene nolu vavanyo lumangalisayo?
clues: Sahamba nomkhosi omkhulu kunye neendlovu ezinamandla zemfazwe sisiya endlwini engcwele
Sasijonge ukuncothula nokutshabalalisa indawo yonqulo eyakhiwe ngabakhonzi boThixo onenceba.
Umhlambi weentaka ezincinci wathunyelwa kuthi, uthwele amatye odongwe ngemilomo nangeenzipho zawo
Sadibana nesandi esasiphosa ngamatye, sasenza sangamanxuwa anyathelweyo
Ndandivela kwilizwe laseYemen kwaye ndandikhonzwa phantsi komlawuli owayefuna ukuhlalisa ingcwele engcwele.
Senziwe umzekelo wabo abo babenobuganga bokuhlambulula indawo engcwele ka-Allah
verse: Did He not make their plan into misguidance? (105:2-4)
